description: Describes the transport parameters of a Sender of urn:x-padl:transport:dante, a native Dante transmit channel. They are the names a Dante receive channel subscribes to it by; the Sender reports them and they are fixed at the constraints endpoint. Dante Senders must support all parameters in this schema.
title: Dante Sender Transport Parameters

device_name.description: Name of the Dante device that transmits the channel: 1 to 31 letters, digits and hyphens.

channel_name.description: Name of the transmit channel on that device: 1 to 31 characters, none of them '@'.
